title: Post-processing strategies for generative design outcomes in a UAV tail boom
authors: Michał Piotr Kowalik, Piotr Stapinski, Mateusz Papis
abstract: Abstract Generative design produces structurally efficient but organically shaped geometries that require post-processing before Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM) manufacturing. This paper compares two post-processing strategies applied to the same generative design outcome for an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) tail boom: a complex variant faithful to the raw topology, and a simplified variant with symmetric arms, self-supporting geometry, and uniform cross-sections oriented toward FDM manufacturability. Both variants were evaluated using linear static and buckling finite element analysis underidentical loading conditions. Scaled prototypes of the simplified variant were FDM-printed at two infill configurations and physically load-tested. The manufacturing-oriented simplification reduced both mass and print time while eliminating support structures; peak stress remained well below the material limit. FEA-predicted stress concentrations correlated with observed fracture locations in physical tests. For lightly loaded polymer FDM structures, these results suggest that manufacturing-oriented simplification of generative design outcomes incurs a negligible structural penalty while improving printability and reducing production cost.
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

infographic.key_insight: Manufacturing-oriented simplification of a generatively designed UAV tail boom reduced mass and print time while maintaining adequate structural performance and eliminating FDM supports.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For lightly loaded polymer FDM components, simplifying organic generative designs can improve manufacturability and reduce production cost with little structural penalty.
method: Compared topology-faithful and simplified tail boom variants derived from the same generative design.
Evaluated both variants using linear static and buckling finite element analysis under identical loads.
FDM-printed scaled simplified prototypes at two infill configurations and physically load-tested them.

infographic.watch_item: Validation used scaled simplified prototypes; full-scale performance, fatigue, and broader loading conditions remain unestablished by the abstract.
infographic.paper_title: Post-processing strategies for generative design outcomes in a UAV tail boom

zh-Hans.title: 无人机尾撑生成式设计结果的后处理策略
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 生成式设计能够产生结构高效但具有有机形态的几何构型，这些构型在采用熔融沉积成型（FDM）制造前需要进行后处理。本文针对同一无人机（UAV）尾撑生成式设计结果，比较了两种后处理策略：一种是忠实于原始拓扑的复杂变体，另一种是面向FDM可制造性的简化变体，具有对称支臂、自支撑几何形状和均匀横截面。在相同载荷条件下，采用线性静力和屈曲有限元分析对两种变体进行了评估。采用两种填充配置，通过FDM打印了简化变体的缩比原型，并进行了实物加载试验。面向制造的简化在消除支撑结构的同时，降低了质量并缩短了打印时间；峰值应力仍远低于材料极限。有限元分析（FEA）预测的应力集中位置与实物试验中观察到的断裂位置相吻合。对于承受较小载荷的聚合物FDM结构，这些结果表明，对生成式设计结果进行面向制造的简化所带来的结构性能损失可忽略不计，同时能够改善可打印性并降低生产成本。

infographic.key_insight: 对生成式设计的无人机尾撑进行面向制造的简化，在保持足够结构性能并消除FDM支撑结构的同时，降低了质量并缩短了打印时间。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于承受较小载荷的聚合物FDM部件，简化具有有机形态的生成式设计可以改善可制造性并降低生产成本，而结构性能损失很小。
method: 比较了源于同一生成式设计的忠实于原始拓扑的尾撑变体与简化尾撑变体。
在相同载荷下，采用线性静力和屈曲有限元分析评估了两种变体。
采用两种填充配置，通过FDM打印了简化变体的缩比原型，并对其进行了实物加载试验。
infographic.evidence_signal: 简化变体的峰值应力仍远低于材料极限，且FEA预测的应力集中位置与观察到的原型断裂位置一致。
infographic.watch_item: 验证采用了简化变体的缩比原型；摘要尚未证实全尺寸性能、疲劳性能以及更广泛载荷条件下的表现。

title: A study on porosity formation in cold-spray additively manufactured 6061 aluminium parts using MIG, TIG and FSW welding processes
authors: Aravinthan Arumugam, Ryan Riedel, Krishnan Kannoorpatti
abstract: Abstract Cold Spray Additive Manufacturing (CSAM) is a solid-state additive manufacturing process that enables components to be produced and repaired without melting the deposited material. However, limited research has examined the weldability of CSAM components. This study investigates porosity formation and local hardness responses in CSAM 6061 aluminium joined using Tungsten Inert Gas (TIG), Metal Inert Gas (MIG), and Friction Stir Welding (FSW), considering both non-heat-treated (NHT) and heat-treated (HT) conditions. Macroscopic, micrographic, ImageJ-based porosity analysis and Vickers hardness measurements were used to characterise the welded regions. TIG and MIG produced substantial fusion zone porosity with characteristics consistent with hydrogen-assisted pore formation during melting and solidification. Pre-weld heat treatment reduced the measured two-dimensional pore area fraction from 26.3% to 18.6% for TIG and from 30.7% to 22.1% for MIG, while also altering pore size and spatial distribution. TIG exhibited relatively large, interconnected pores extending from the fusion boundary, whereas MIG showed a greater population of smaller pores concentrated towards the upper weld region. Both fusion processes produced local hardness reductions, with hardness recovery of approximately 50–56% for TIG and 63–67% for MIG relative to the corresponding control regions. In contrast, FSW exhibited substantially less macro-porosity, predominantly finer residual microporosity, and hardness recovery of approximately 82–84%. Overall, under the conditions investigated, FSW exhibited lower macro-porosity and more localised hardness reduction than TIG and MIG, while pre-weld heat treatment improved the porosity characteristics of both fusion welding processes.
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

infographic.key_insight: For cold-spray additively manufactured 6061 aluminium, FSW showed substantially less macro-porosity and higher local hardness recovery than TIG or MIG under the tested conditions.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Welding-process selection and pre-weld heat treatment can improve joint-region quality when joining or repairing CSAM aluminium components.
method: Compared TIG, MIG and FSW in non-heat-treated and heat-treated CSAM 6061 aluminium.
Characterised welded regions using macrographs, micrographs and ImageJ-based porosity analysis.
Measured local hardness using Vickers testing.
infographic.evidence_signal: Pre-weld heat treatment reduced 2D pore area fraction from 26.3% to 18.6% for TIG and 30.7% to 22.1% for MIG; hardness recovery relative to corresponding controls was approximately 50–56% for TIG, 63–67% for MIG and 82–84% for FSW.
infographic.watch_item: Two-dimensional porosity and local hardness measurements do not establish three-dimensional defect content or joint strength and fatigue performance.
infographic.paper_title: A study on porosity formation in cold-spray additively manufactured 6061 aluminium parts using MIG, TIG and FSW welding processes

zh-Hans.title: 采用MIG、TIG和FSW焊接工艺的冷喷涂增材制造6061铝零件气孔形成研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 冷喷涂增材制造（CSAM）是一种固态增材制造工艺，可在不熔化沉积材料的情况下制造和修复部件。然而，针对CSAM部件可焊性的研究仍然有限。本研究考察了采用钨极惰性气体保护焊（TIG）、熔化极惰性气体保护焊（MIG）和搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）连接的CSAM 6061铝中的气孔形成及局部硬度响应，同时考虑了未热处理（NHT）和热处理（HT）状态。采用宏观观察、显微观察、基于ImageJ的孔隙率分析和维氏硬度测量对焊接区域进行表征。TIG和MIG在熔合区产生了大量气孔，其特征与熔化和凝固过程中氢辅助气孔形成机制相符。焊前热处理使TIG的实测二维孔隙面积分数从26.3%降至18.6%，使MIG的实测二维孔隙面积分数从30.7%降至22.1%，同时也改变了孔隙尺寸及其空间分布。TIG呈现出从熔合边界延伸的较大且相互连通的气孔，而MIG则呈现出数量更多、集中于焊缝上部区域的较小气孔。两种熔焊工艺均导致局部硬度下降，相对于相应对照区域，TIG的硬度恢复率约为50–56%，MIG约为63–67%。相比之下，FSW的宏观孔隙显著较少，残余孔隙主要为更细小的微孔，硬度恢复率约为82–84%。总体而言，在本研究条件下，与TIG和MIG相比，FSW呈现出更少的宏观孔隙，且硬度下降更为局部化；焊前热处理则改善了两种熔焊工艺的孔隙特征。

infographic.key_insight: 对于冷喷涂增材制造6061铝，在所测试条件下，FSW比TIG或MIG呈现出显著更少的宏观孔隙和更高的局部硬度恢复率。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 在连接或修复CSAM铝部件时，焊接工艺选择和焊前热处理可改善接头区域的质量。
method: 比较了未热处理和热处理状态下CSAM 6061铝的TIG、MIG和FSW焊接。
采用宏观图像、显微图像和基于ImageJ的孔隙率分析对焊接区域进行表征。
采用维氏硬度试验测量局部硬度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 焊前热处理使TIG的二维孔隙面积分数从26.3%降至18.6%，使MIG的二维孔隙面积分数从30.7%降至22.1%；相对于相应对照区域，TIG的硬度恢复率约为50–56%，MIG约为63–67%，FSW约为82–84%。
infographic.watch_item: 二维孔隙率和局部硬度测量不能确定三维缺陷含量，也不能确定接头强度和疲劳性能。

title: Analysis of Wear-Resistant Coating Technologies for Extending the Service Life of Ventilation Mill Components
authors: Marko Ristić, Ivana Vasovic Maksimović, Aleksandar Stepanovic, Ljubomir Nešovanović, Mirko Maksimović
abstract: Within Thermal Power Plants, the components of the ventilation mill operate under complex conditions. Despite the operation conditions of high temperatures, these components are exposed to a high level of wear due to dust and sand particles flowing through the system. This paper aims to analyse the enhancement of the wear resistance of the ventilation mill. Within this research, a CFD analysis was performed as a comprehensive tool to determine the critical zones in the system. Considering the working conditions, it is emphasized that these components are characterized by high velocity particle flows, sand concentrations reaching up to 40%, and the presence of other abrasive mineral particles. Within this research, the application of various wear-resistant coatings is analyzed through detailed experimental testing to confirm the validity of each solution and establish an optimal proposition. Applying the various deposition techniques was considered, including manual metal arc welding, high-velocity oxygen fuel (HVOF) spraying, and plasma welding, utilizing filler materials with diverse chemical compositions. Using scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and Energy- Dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS), the structure and distribution of chemical elements of the coatings were determined. Determination of hardness distribution across a cross-section of samples is important in selecting the coating, and in this paper, it is analyzed, and the results are presented. For the experimental testing, a special controlled sandblasting chamber was used in this research, where the working conditions are simulated with an abrasive environment, as is in ventilation mills. The results of these experiments underscore the critical role of SEM-EDS analyses in correlating the microstructural and compositional properties of coatings with their wear performance, providing valuable insights into optimizing materials and deposition processes for enhanced durability.
venue: Diffusion and defect data, solid state data. Part B, Solid state phenomena/Solid state phenomena

infographic.key_insight: Combining CFD-guided wear-zone identification with coating characterization and abrasion testing supports selection of wear-resistant coatings for ventilation mill components.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Appropriate coating materials and deposition processes could extend component service life under hot, high-velocity flows containing abrasive minerals and sand concentrations up to 40%.
method: Use CFD to identify critical wear zones.
Evaluate coatings deposited by manual metal arc welding, HVOF spraying, and plasma welding.
Characterize coatings using SEM-EDS, cross-sectional hardness measurements, and controlled sandblasting tests.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports microstructural, compositional, hardness, and simulated abrasion evaluations but provides no numerical wear reductions or coating rankings.
infographic.watch_item: Laboratory sandblasting performance requires validation under coupled thermal and abrasive conditions in operating mills.
infographic.paper_title: Analysis of Wear-Resistant Coating Technologies for Extending the Service Life of Ventilation Mill Components

zh-Hans.title: 延长通风磨机部件使用寿命的耐磨涂层技术分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 在火力发电厂中，通风磨机部件的运行条件十分复杂。这些部件不仅在高温条件下运行，还因流经系统的粉尘和砂粒而遭受严重磨损。本文旨在分析如何提高通风磨机的耐磨性。本研究采用计算流体力学（CFD）分析作为综合工具，以确定系统中的关键区域。结合工况，研究强调这些部件面临高速颗粒流、最高达40%的砂含量，以及其他磨蚀性矿物颗粒的作用。本研究通过详细的实验测试分析了多种耐磨涂层的应用，以验证各方案的有效性并提出最优方案。研究考虑了多种沉积技术，包括手工电弧焊、高速氧燃料（HVOF）喷涂和等离子焊，并采用了具有不同化学成分的填充材料。利用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和能量色散X射线能谱（EDS），确定了涂层的结构及化学元素分布。测定试样横截面上的硬度分布对于涂层选择具有重要意义，本文对此进行了分析并给出了结果。在实验测试中，本研究使用了专用的可控喷砂室，通过磨蚀性环境模拟通风磨机的工况。这些实验结果凸显了SEM-EDS分析在关联涂层微观结构、成分特性与耐磨性能方面的关键作用，为优化材料和沉积工艺以提高耐久性提供了有价值的认识。

infographic.key_insight: 将CFD指导的磨损区域识别与涂层表征和磨蚀试验相结合，可为通风磨机部件耐磨涂层的选择提供支持。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 适当的涂层材料和沉积工艺有望延长部件在高温、高速流动条件下的使用寿命，此类流动中含有磨蚀性矿物，砂含量最高可达40%。
method: 利用CFD识别关键磨损区域。
评估采用手工电弧焊、HVOF喷涂和等离子焊沉积的涂层。
采用SEM-EDS、横截面硬度测量和可控喷砂试验对涂层进行表征。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了微观结构、成分、硬度和模拟磨蚀评估，但未提供磨损降低幅度的数值或涂层性能排序。
infographic.watch_item: 实验室喷砂条件下的性能仍需在实际运行磨机的热与磨蚀耦合条件下进行验证。

title: Spatial characteristic of temperature distribution and material flow behaviors during bobbin tool friction stir welding: a computational fluid dynamics study
authors: Honghua Han, Xu Yan, Yanhua Zhao, Suhong Zhang, Qingyu Shi, Chengle Yang
abstract: Abstract The incorporation of dual shoulders endows bobbin tool friction stir welding (BT-FSW) with spatially distinct heat transfer and material flow characteristics relative to conventional FSW. The vague understanding of these processes hinders efficient optimization of BT-FSW. To address this gap, a computational fluid dynamics (CFD) model, which considered the fully coupling of thermo-mechanical-fluid, was established. Three contact pressure models, namely the Front-Peaked Contact Pressure Model (FP-CPM), Uniform Contact Pressure Model (U-CPM), and Rear-Peaked Contact Pressure Model (RP-CPM), were proposed to model the pressure distribution at the tool-workpiece (T/W) interface. The results show that the distribution of contact pressure at the T/W interface constitutes a critical factor governing the temperature field and flow behavior during welding stage. The FP-CPM provided superior predictive accuracy for the welding temperature, the shape of plastic deformation zone, and material flow trajectories, compared to U-CPM and RP-CPM. Agreed by both experiment and prediction, the temperature on the retreating side (RS) exceeded that on the advancing side (AS). Revealed by FP-CPM model, this phenomenon is attributable to the deflection of high-temperature material from the AS toward the RS, driven by the intense material flow ahead of the tool induced by the high-pressure zone. At the T/W interface, the material exhibited asymmetric horizontal flow with a thin layer ahead of the tool and a broader low-speed region behind the tool. Concurrently, vertical migration featured circumferential flow around the tool converging toward the plate mid-thickness.

infographic.key_insight: Front-peaked tool–workpiece contact pressure best explains bobbin tool friction stir welding behavior, including hotter material on the retreating side caused by flow from the advancing side.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Accurate contact-pressure modeling can improve predictions of weld temperature, plastic deformation, and material transport to support process optimization.
method: Developed a fully coupled thermo-mechanical-fluid CFD model.
Compared front-peaked, uniform, and rear-peaked contact-pressure distributions.
Analyzed temperature fields, deformation-zone shape, and horizontal and vertical material flow.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports superior predictive accuracy for the front-peaked model and experimental agreement that the retreating side is hotter than the advancing side, but provides no quantitative error metrics.
infographic.watch_item: Transferability of the front-peaked pressure model across materials, tool geometries, and welding conditions requires further validation.
infographic.paper_title: Spatial characteristic of temperature distribution and material flow behaviors during bobbin tool friction stir welding: a computational fluid dynamics study

zh-Hans.title: 双轴肩搅拌摩擦焊过程中温度分布与材料流动行为的空间特征：计算流体力学研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 双轴肩的引入使双轴肩搅拌摩擦焊（BT-FSW）具有不同于传统搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）的空间传热与材料流动特征。对这些过程的认识尚不清晰，阻碍了BT-FSW的高效优化。为弥补这一不足，建立了考虑热-力-流完全耦合的计算流体力学（CFD）模型。提出了三种接触压力模型，即前部峰值接触压力模型（FP-CPM）、均匀接触压力模型（U-CPM）和后部峰值接触压力模型（RP-CPM），用于模拟工具-工件（T/W）界面的压力分布。结果表明，T/W界面的接触压力分布是控制焊接阶段温度场和流动行为的关键因素。与U-CPM和RP-CPM相比，FP-CPM对焊接温度、塑性变形区形状和材料流动轨迹的预测精度更高。实验与预测结果均表明，后退侧（RS）的温度高于前进侧（AS）。FP-CPM模型揭示，这一现象源于高压区在工具前方诱发的强烈材料流动，驱使高温材料从AS偏转至RS。在T/W界面，材料呈现不对称的水平流动特征，工具前方的流动层较薄，而工具后方存在较宽的低速区。同时，竖直方向的迁移表现为绕工具的周向流动向板厚中部汇聚。

infographic.key_insight: 前部峰值工具-工件接触压力最能解释双轴肩搅拌摩擦焊的行为，包括由前进侧流向后退侧的材料流动导致后退侧材料温度更高这一现象。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 准确的接触压力建模可提高焊接温度、塑性变形和材料输运的预测精度，为工艺优化提供支持。
method: 建立了热-力-流完全耦合的CFD模型。
比较了前部峰值、均匀和后部峰值接触压力分布。
分析了温度场、变形区形状以及水平和竖直方向的材料流动。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了前部峰值模型具有更高的预测精度，且后退侧温度高于前进侧的预测与实验结果一致，但未提供定量误差指标。
infographic.watch_item: 前部峰值压力模型对不同材料、工具几何形状和焊接条件的适用性仍需进一步验证。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: Combining physics-based simulation and neural networks mapped HDPE friction stir welding quality, identifying 1500 rpm, 30 mm/min and 60 °C bottom preheating as optimal within the tested conditions.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Bottom preheating reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N to about 1100 N, supporting more stable welding and defect-resistant HDPE joints.
method: Developed a 3D Coupled Eulerian–Lagrangian model of temperature, force, material flow and defect formation.
Trained two multilayer perceptron neural networks on experimental temperature and axial-force data.
Combined simulation and ANN predictions to map defective and defect-free process windows.
infographic.evidence_signal: Experiments validated simulated thermal, mechanical and void-formation responses; ANN temperature and force predictions achieved R² values of 0.91–0.99 across tested conditions.
infographic.watch_item: Performance beyond the tested processing conditions remains unestablished, so new operating ranges require validation.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于预测高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量的计算建模与机器学习方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被公认为连接热塑性材料的有效技术。本研究结合计算与机器学习方法，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接温度、垂直轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等特征进行全面预测，并通过实验结果加以验证。研究建立了三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，用于模拟不同转速、焊接速度及底部预热条件下的HDPE焊接过程。CEL数值模型经实验数据验证，在孔洞形成以及热响应和力学响应的预测方面表现出很高的一致性。结果表明，底面预热能够有效减小温度梯度，并使垂直力波动趋于稳定。定量而言，60 °C底面预热使峰值压入力从1600 N降至接近1100 N，并使峰值温度从未预热时的70 °C升至约100 °C，从而减小厚度方向的温度梯度，使轴向力分布趋于稳定。同时，研究使用实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），以预测温度和轴向力的时间响应，R2介于0.91与0.99之间，表明其在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高的准确性和较强的泛化能力。CEL计算模拟准确预测了焊接区域形貌，包括搅拌区、热机械影响区和热影响区；而CEL–ANN组合框架能够快速生成工艺图，标示存在缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口。在1500 rpm、30 mm/min和60 °C预热条件下获得了最佳工艺条件，而在1000 rpm且未预热时，由于形成虫洞缺陷，观察到较差的焊接性。这些发现为制备可靠的HDPE接头提供了以工艺为导向的设计指南，并展示了如何通过融合计算建模与机器学习实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW工艺的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，同时支持该工艺在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

title: Microstructure and surface performance of detonation gun sprayed 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 substrate for structural applications
authors: T. Sampath kumar, Rajaram Ganesan, M.M. Reddy
abstract: Two protective coatings, 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY, were deposited on Al 6061-T6 alloy substrates using the Detonation Gun (D-Gun) thermal spray process. The deposited coatings were studied for their microstructure, phase composition, surface roughness, hardness, corrosion behaviour, wettability, and solid particle erosion resistance. Characterisation was done using SEM-EDS, XRD, AFM, nanoindentation, potentiodynamic polarisation, contact angle measurement, and erosion testing. SEM-EDS results showed that both coatings bonded well to the substrate with uniform thickness. The NiCrAlY coating had a denser microstructure with lower porosity compared to 80Ni20Cr. XRD identified CrNi phases with FCC crystal structure in 80Ni20Cr and Al₂NiY phases with orthorhombic structure in NiCrAlY. Nanocrystalline grain structure was observed in both coatings. AFM measurements showed that NiCrAlY had the lowest surface roughness among all three samples. Nanoindentation results showed that NiCrAlY hardness is approximately 10 times higher than 80Ni20Cr. Specifically, NiCrAlY showed a hardness of 7895.36 MPa (731.2 HV), compared with 780.11 MPa (72.25 HV) for 80Ni20Cr and 708.68 MPa for the uncoated Al 6061 substrate. Potentiodynamic polarisation tests in 3.5 wt% NaCl solution confirmed that NiCrAlY recorded the lowest corrosion current density of 6.625 × 10 -7 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.00567 mmpy. The 80Ni20Cr coating gave a corrosion current density of 1.585 × 10 - 6 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.01427 mmpy. Both figures are considerably lower than the bare substrate at 0.5185 mmpy. Contact angle measurements confirmed superhydrophobic behaviour for NiCrAlY and near-superhydrophobic behaviour for 80Ni20Cr. Solid particle erosion test results showed that 80Ni20Cr recorded the lowest mass loss. Under the laboratory conditions used (3.5 wt% NaCl at room temperature; a single erosion condition of 90° impact angle, 40 m/s and 5 min), NiCrAlY showed the better hardness and corrosion resistance, whereas 80Ni20Cr showed the better erosion resistance. These results indicate relative performance under the test conditions and are not a prediction of long-term service life.

infographic.key_insight: D-Gun-sprayed NiCrAlY offered greater hardness and corrosion resistance, while 80Ni20Cr showed better solid-particle erosion resistance on Al 6061-T6.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Coating selection should reflect the dominant damage mechanism: NiCrAlY for hardness and corrosion protection, or 80Ni20Cr for erosion resistance under the tested conditions.

zh-Hans.title: 面向结构应用的Al 6061-T6基体上爆炸喷涂80Ni20Cr和NiCrAlY涂层的微观组织与表面性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷涂（D-Gun）热喷涂工艺，在Al 6061-T6合金基体上沉积了80Ni20Cr和NiCrAlY两种防护涂层。研究了所沉积涂层的微观组织、物相组成、表面粗糙度、硬度、腐蚀行为、润湿性和抗固体颗粒冲蚀性能。采用SEM-EDS、XRD、AFM、纳米压痕、动电位极化、接触角测量和冲蚀试验进行表征。SEM-EDS结果表明，两种涂层均与基体结合良好，且厚度均匀。与80Ni20Cr相比，NiCrAlY涂层的微观组织更致密，孔隙率更低。XRD在80Ni20Cr中鉴定出具有面心立方（FCC）晶体结构的CrNi相，在NiCrAlY中鉴定出具有正交晶体结构的Al₂NiY相。两种涂层中均观察到纳米晶组织。AFM测量表明，在全部三个样品中，NiCrAlY的表面粗糙度最低。纳米压痕结果表明，NiCrAlY的硬度约为80Ni20Cr的10倍。具体而言，NiCrAlY的硬度为7895.36 MPa（731.2 HV），而80Ni20Cr的硬度为780.11 MPa（72.25 HV），未涂覆Al 6061基体的硬度为708.68 MPa。在3.5 wt% NaCl溶液中进行的动电位极化试验证实，NiCrAlY的腐蚀电流密度最低，为6.625 × 10⁻⁷ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为0.00567 mmpy。80Ni20Cr涂层的腐蚀电流密度为1.585 × 10⁻⁶ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为0.01427 mmpy。这两个腐蚀速率均显著低于裸基体的0.5185 mmpy。接触角测量证实，NiCrAlY呈现超疏水行为，80Ni20Cr呈现接近超疏水的行为。固体颗粒冲蚀试验结果表明，80Ni20Cr的质量损失最小。在所采用的实验室条件下（室温下的3.5 wt% NaCl溶液；冲击角度90°、速度40 m/s、持续时间5 min的单一冲蚀条件），NiCrAlY表现出更高的硬度和更好的耐腐蚀性，而80Ni20Cr表现出更好的抗冲蚀性能。这些结果反映了试验条件下的相对性能，并非对长期服役寿命的预测。

title: Physics-informed multi-sensor fusion framework for predicting weld penetration state and mechanistic discovery in CMT welding
authors: Yu Zhang, Kai Yang, Xudong Niu, Kailong Meng, Wenlong Zheng, Jiadui Chen
abstract: Accurate recognition of weld states is essential for ensuring structural integrity in cold metal transfer (CMT) welding. However, it remains challenging to develop models that are both robust to industrial disturbances and physically interpretable. In addition, the inherent opacity of current data-driven methods often limits their reliability in complex manufacturing environments. This study proposes ASPIS-Net, a robust physics-informed network for interpretable CMT weld-state monitoring. The proposed network adopts a dual-branch architecture with an adaptive gated fusion mechanism, which dynamically suppresses environmental noise while preserving critical acoustic and electrical features. To improve model transparency, a symbolic regression framework is further introduced to convert the learned representations into explicit physical equations, thereby aligning deep-learning predictions with the underlying welding thermodynamics. The proposed method was validated using an automated CMT welding platform, from which 5,000 synchronised acoustic and electrical signal samples were collected under four typical penetration states. The results show that ASPIS-Net achieves a classification accuracy of 99.36% and retains a Macro-F1 score of 75.59% under the 0 dB composite-noise condition. This work provides a transparent, physics-guided approach for monitoring multi-physics manufacturing processes, establishing a rational basis for assessing structural reliability in critical welded joints.

infographic.key_insight: ASPIS-Net combines acoustic and electrical signals with physics-informed learning to classify CMT weld penetration states and derive interpretable equations.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Noise-resilient, interpretable weld-state monitoring could support quality assurance for structurally critical welded joints.

zh-Hans.title: 用于预测 CMT 焊接熔透状态与机理发现的物理信息多传感器融合框架
zh-Hans.abstract: 准确识别焊接状态对于确保冷金属过渡（CMT）焊接的结构完整性至关重要。然而，开发既能抵抗工业扰动又具有物理可解释性的模型仍面临挑战。此外，现有数据驱动方法固有的不透明性往往限制了其在复杂制造环境中的可靠性。本研究提出了 ASPIS-Net，这是一种用于可解释 CMT 焊接状态监测的鲁棒物理信息网络。该网络采用具有自适应门控融合机制的双分支架构，可在保留关键声学和电信号特征的同时动态抑制环境噪声。为提高模型透明度，进一步引入符号回归框架，将学习到的表征转换为显式物理方程，从而使深度学习预测与焊接的底层热力学机理相一致。所提出的方法在自动化 CMT 焊接平台上进行了验证，并在四种典型熔透状态下采集了 5,000 个同步声学和电信号样本。结果表明，ASPIS-Net 的分类准确率达到 99.36%，并在 0 dB 复合噪声条件下保持了 75.59% 的 Macro-F1 分数。本研究为多物理场制造过程监测提供了一种透明的、物理引导的方法，为评估关键焊接接头的结构可靠性建立了合理依据。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: HVAF-sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr offered the best combined wear and corrosion performance, while HVOF produced the highest measured hardness.
infographic.engineering_relevance: HVAF is a promising coating route for 304 stainless steel components requiring both wear protection and corrosion resistance.

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、超音速氧燃料喷涂和超音速空气燃料喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层的微观组织、耐磨性与耐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性和耐蚀性。分别采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、超音速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和超音速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，在304不锈钢基体上制备了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层，并系统研究和比较了这些涂层的微观组织、摩擦学性能和耐蚀性。结果表明，采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV，均高于304不锈钢。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10⁻⁵、(1.51±0.20)×10⁻⁵、(1.17±0.10)×10⁻⁵和(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，均低于304不锈钢。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可观察到剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体，因此这三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层。其中，HVOF和HVAF涂层的耐磨性能更好。耐蚀性由高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。在本研究中，HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位(-0.37±0.01 VSCE)、最小的腐蚀电流密度(1.75±0.02 μA/cm²)和最大的腐蚀电阻(20438.5 Ω)。APS涂层的耐蚀性在这四种涂层中最差。

title: Effect of Laser Remelting on the Microstructure, Mechanical and Tribological Properties of Detonation-Sprayed NiCrFeBSiC Coatings for Mechanical Engineering Applications
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Laila Sulyubayeva, A.Y. Zhakupova, Daryn Baizhan, Nurbol Berdimuratov
abstract: This study investigates the effect of laser remelting on the microstructure, phase composition, mechanical properties, tribological behavior, and corrosion resistance of self-fluxing NiCrFeBSiC coatings deposited onto AISI 321 stainless steel by detonation spraying. The coatings were characterized before and after laser treatment using scanning electron microscopy (SEM), energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS), X-ray diffraction (XRD), instrumented indentation, adhesion testing, ball-on-disk tribometry, and potentiodynamic polarization measurements. SEM analysis revealed that laser remelting reduced coating porosity from 0.306 ± 0.014% to 0.15 ± 0.09%, accompanied by microstructural densification and a reduction in coating thickness. XRD analysis confirmed the preservation of the principal crystalline phases, including Ni3Fe, Cr7C3, CrB, and Ni3B, following laser treatment. The Vickers hardness increased from 1049.1 ± 43.4 to 1206.1 ± 63.1 HV, while the elastic modulus increased from 233.6 ± 6.2 to 258.4 ± 5.3 GPa. Furthermore, adhesion strength increased by 19.4%, whereas surface roughness decreased by 19.2%. Laser remelting significantly improved tribological performance, reducing the average coefficient of friction from 0.535 ± 0.048 to 0.409 ± 0.086 and the specific wear rate from 2.864 × 10−4 to 1.447 × 10−4 mm3/(N·m), corresponding to a 49.5% reduction in wear. Electrochemical measurements indicated a modest decrease in corrosion current density of approximately 3.0%, accompanied by changes in the morphology of corrosion-affected regions. The improvements are associated with laser-induced microstructural densification, redistribution of alloying elements, and preservation of hard reinforcing phases. These findings demonstrate the potential of combining detonation spraying with laser remelting to produce wear-resistant nickel-based protective coatings for mechanical and power engineering applications.

zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了激光重熔对采用爆炸喷涂在AISI 321不锈钢上制备的自熔性NiCrFeBSiC涂层的微观组织、相组成、力学性能、摩擦学行为及耐腐蚀性的影响。采用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、能量色散X射线能谱（EDS）、X射线衍射（XRD）、仪器化压入测试、结合强度测试、球盘摩擦试验及动电位极化测量，对激光处理前后的涂层进行表征。SEM分析表明，激光重熔使涂层孔隙率从0.306 ± 0.014%降至0.15 ± 0.09%，同时伴随微观组织致密化和涂层厚度减小。XRD分析证实，激光处理后，Ni3Fe、Cr7C3、CrB和Ni3B等主要晶相得以保留。维氏硬度从1049.1 ± 43.4 HV提高至1206.1 ± 63.1 HV，弹性模量从233.6 ± 6.2 GPa提高至258.4 ± 5.3 GPa。此外，结合强度提高了19.4%，表面粗糙度降低了19.2%。激光重熔显著改善了摩擦学性能，使平均摩擦系数从0.535 ± 0.048降至0.409 ± 0.086，比磨损率从2.864 × 10−4 mm3/(N·m)降至1.447 × 10−4 mm3/(N·m)，对应磨损降低49.5%。电化学测量表明，腐蚀电流密度小幅降低约3.0%，同时受腐蚀区域的形貌发生变化。这些性能改善与激光引起的微观组织致密化、合金元素再分布以及硬质强化相的保留有关。这些结果表明，将爆炸喷涂与激光重熔相结合，有望制备用于机械与动力工程领域的耐磨镍基防护涂层。

title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

title: Effect of Laser Post-Treatment on the Microstructure, Mechanical and Tribological Properties of Detonation- and Flame-Sprayed Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C Coatings
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Aiym Nabioldina, Dosym Yerbolatuly, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: This study investigates the effect of laser post-treatment on the microstructure, phase composition, mechanical, and tribological properties of self-fluxing Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C coatings deposited by detonation spraying (DS) and gas-flame spraying (GFS) onto AISI 321 stainless steel substrates. The coatings before and after laser treatment (LT) were examined using scanning electron microscopy, energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy, X-ray diffraction, instrumented indentation, and ball-on-disk tribological testing. The as-deposited coatings were characterized by a dense structure and low porosity, amounting to 0.306 ± 0.014% for the DS coatings and 0.433 ± 0.011% for the GFS coatings. Phase analysis revealed a multiphase structure consisting predominantly of a γ-(Ni,Fe) matrix reinforced by Cr7C3 carbide, CrB and Ni3B borides, as well as Ni31Si12 silicide. After laser treatment, the main crystalline phases were preserved; however, changes in the relative intensities of the diffraction peaks were observed, suggesting microstructural modifications during rapid melting and subsequent solidification. The mechanical response to laser treatment depended on the coating deposition method. For the DS coating, Vickers hardness increased from 1049.1 ± 43.4 to 1206.1 ± 63.1 HV, while the elastic modulus increased from 233.6 ± 6.2 to 258.4 ± 5.3 GPa. For the GFS coating, hardness increased from 1096.2 ± 58.8 to 1121.3 ± 49.1 HV, whereas the elastic modulus decreased from 228.0 ± 5.9 to 187.0 ± 8.8 GPa. Laser treatment also improved the wear resistance of both coating types. The wear rate of the DS coating decreased from 1.939 × 10−4 to 1.465 × 10−4 mm3/(N × m), while that of the GFS coating decreased from 2.419 × 10−4 to 1.476 × 10−4 mm3/(N × m), corresponding to reductions of approximately 24% and 39%, respectively. Under dry sliding conditions, the coefficient of friction of the DS coating remained nearly unchanged after laser treatment, decreasing slightly from 0.627 to 0.620, whereas that of the GFS coating decreased from 0.623 to 0.582. These findings demonstrate that laser post-treatment can improve the mechanical and tribological performance of self-fluxing Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C coatings, with the magnitude and nature of these improvements depending on the initial microstructure formed by the respective spraying method.

zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了激光后处理对采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和气体火焰喷涂（GFS）在AISI 321不锈钢基体上制备的自熔性Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C涂层的微观组织、相组成、力学性能及摩擦学性能的影响。采用扫描电子显微镜、能量色散X射线能谱、X射线衍射、仪器化压入测试和球盘式摩擦学测试，对激光处理（LT）前后的涂层进行了表征。喷涂态涂层具有致密组织和低孔隙率，其中DS涂层的孔隙率为0.306 ± 0.014%，GFS涂层为0.433 ± 0.011%。物相分析表明，涂层呈多相结构，主要由γ-(Ni,Fe)基体以及起增强作用的Cr7C3碳化物、CrB和Ni3B硼化物、Ni31Si12硅化物组成。激光处理后，主要晶相得以保留，但衍射峰的相对强度发生了变化，表明快速熔化及随后凝固过程中可能发生了微观组织变化。涂层对激光处理的力学响应取决于涂层的沉积方法。DS涂层的维氏硬度从1049.1 ± 43.4 HV提高至1206.1 ± 63.1 HV，弹性模量从233.6 ± 6.2 GPa提高至258.4 ± 5.3 GPa。GFS涂层的硬度从1096.2 ± 58.8 HV提高至1121.3 ± 49.1 HV，而弹性模量从228.0 ± 5.9 GPa降低至187.0 ± 8.8 GPa。激光处理还提高了两类涂层的耐磨性。DS涂层的磨损率从1.939 × 10−4 mm3/(N × m)降低至1.465 × 10−4 mm3/(N × m)，GFS涂层的磨损率从2.419 × 10−4 mm3/(N × m)降低至1.476 × 10−4 mm3/(N × m)，降幅分别约为24%和39%。在干滑动条件下，DS涂层的摩擦系数在激光处理后几乎保持不变，仅从0.627略微降低至0.620，而GFS涂层的摩擦系数从0.623降低至0.582。这些结果表明，激光后处理能够改善自熔性Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C涂层的力学性能和摩擦学性能，而改善的幅度和具体表现取决于相应喷涂方法形成的初始微观组织。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.engineering_relevance: These parameter–response relationships can guide welding process optimization for low-expansion Invar tooling used in aerospace composite manufacturing.

zh-Hans.title: Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中的熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: Invar钢具有极低的热膨胀系数，因此广泛用于航空航天复合材料模具的制造。现有研究大多侧重于工艺方面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，采用数值模拟和高速摄影，分析了不同工艺参数对Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接过程中熔池形貌演变及电弧特性的影响，为Invar钢焊接工艺优化提供了关键的理论支持。结果表明，在5 ~ 6 kW的激光功率范围内，功率增大使反冲压力增大，从而增大熔深和小孔尺寸，增强熔池整体流动，且在高功率下电弧易受激光吸引而发生偏转。在0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min的焊接速度范围内，焊接速度提高使热输入降低，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，熔池流速和冷却速率增大；此外，高速下电弧易发生变形。在150 ~ 170 A的焊接电流范围内，电流增大使电弧力增强，促进焊缝宽度增大并强化熔池对流；此外，高电流下电弧更加稳定。

title: EFFECT OF CEO2 AND LA2O3 REINFORCEMENTS ON MECHANICAL, TRIBOLOGICAL AND MICROSTRUCTURAL PROPERTIES OF WC–12CO COATING BY HIGH-VELOCITY OXYGEN FUEL DEPOSITION TECHNIQUE
authors: Satyanarayan Dubey, Shyam Birla, Tribhuwan Kishore Mishra
abstract: Decarburization during HVOF deposition reduces the workability of Tungsten Carbide-12% Cobalt (WC-12Co) coatings. This work examines how CeO2 and La2O3 reinforcements affect HVOF-sprayed WC-12Co coatings' mechanical, tribological, and microstructural characteristics. Compared to the unreinforced coating, microstructure, phase composition, bond strength, abrasive wear, coefficient of friction, and microhardness were assessed. CeO2 or La2O3 decreased porosity and finer grain structure without affecting bond strength. Coatings with 1 wt.% CeO2 and La2O3 increased microhardness by 6% and 4%, respectively, compared to the unreinforced WC-12Co coating, which had an adhesive bond strength of 73.60 ± 5 MPa. Both changed coatings improved structural stability, grain refinement, and densification. Minimum wear rate of 3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/N·m was found in WC-12Co-1La2O3, whereas the lowest coefficient of friction was 0.4 in WC-12Co-1CeO2. An oxide layer from reinforcements enhanced wear resistance. SEM investigation of worn surfaces showed debris, dislodged carbide particles, SiC grains, microcracks, and grooves as the predominant wear processes.

infographic.key_insight: Adding 1 wt.% CeO₂ or La₂O₃ to HVOF-sprayed WC–12Co refined the microstructure, reduced porosity, and improved hardness and wear performance without affecting bond strength.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Rare-earth oxide reinforcement offers a route to denser, more wear-resistant WC–12Co coatings for components exposed to abrasive contact.

zh-Hans.title: CeO2和La2O3增强相对高速氧燃料喷涂技术制备的WC–12Co涂层力学性能、摩擦学性能及微观组织的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 高速氧燃料（HVOF）喷涂过程中的脱碳会降低碳化钨-12%钴（WC-12Co）涂层的加工性能。本研究考察了CeO2和La2O3增强相对HVOF喷涂WC-12Co涂层力学性能、摩擦学性能及微观组织特征的影响。以未增强涂层为对照，评估了微观组织、物相组成、结合强度、磨粒磨损、摩擦系数和显微硬度。CeO2或La2O3降低了孔隙率并细化了晶粒，且未影响结合强度。与未增强WC-12Co涂层相比，添加1 wt.% CeO2和La2O3的涂层显微硬度分别提高了6%和4%；未增强涂层的黏附结合强度为73.60 ± 5 MPa。两种改性涂层均表现出更好的组织稳定性、更细的晶粒和更高的致密度。WC-12Co-1La2O3的磨损率最低，为3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/N·m，而WC-12Co-1CeO2的摩擦系数最低，为0.4。由增强相形成的氧化层提高了耐磨性。对磨损表面的SEM观察表明，磨屑、脱落的碳化物颗粒、SiC晶粒、微裂纹和沟槽是主要磨损现象。

infographic.key_insight: 向HVOF喷涂WC–12Co涂层中添加1 wt.% CeO₂或La₂O₃，可细化微观组织、降低孔隙率，并提高硬度和耐磨性能，同时不影响结合强度。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 稀土氧化物增强为承受磨粒接触的部件提供了一条制备更致密、更耐磨的WC–12Co涂层的途径。

比较微观组织、物相组成、结合强度、显微硬度、磨粒磨损和摩擦性能。

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

infographic.key_insight: WC–Co–Cr coating performance depends on powder morphology and spraying method: detonation spraying favors hardness, while HVOF yields a dense, uniform coating with low friction.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Powder and process selection can help tailor wear-resistant coatings for machine parts exposed to intensive friction and high loads.

Examine powder morphology and coating microstructure using SEM and EDS.
Evaluate coating microhardness and tribological properties.

zh-Hans.title: 采用HVOF和爆炸喷涂制备的WC–Co–Cr涂层的组织形成与耐磨性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文对采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）方法沉积的WC–Co–Cr金属陶瓷涂层进行了对比分析。研究采用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和能量色散谱（EDS），分析了原始粉末的形貌以及涂层的显微组织和相组成。结果表明，使用均匀、完全合金化的WC–Co–Cr粉末可确保形成致密的层状组织，且碳化物相在金属基体内均匀分布。爆炸喷涂可制备硬度更高的涂层（平均显微硬度为1449 HV），而HVOF可制备致密度高、显微组织均匀且摩擦系数低（Kt = 0.143）的涂层。对比分析证实，涂层的力学性能和摩擦学性能在很大程度上取决于粉末形貌和喷涂方法。这些研究结果有助于确定WC–Co–Cr涂层的最佳工艺条件，从而提高机械零件的耐磨性和耐久性，这对于在剧烈摩擦和高载荷条件下运行的零件尤为重要。

infographic.key_insight: WC–Co–Cr涂层的性能取决于粉末形貌和喷涂方法：爆炸喷涂有利于提高硬度，而HVOF可获得致密、均匀且摩擦系数低的涂层。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 粉末和工艺的选择有助于为承受剧烈摩擦和高载荷的机械零件定制耐磨涂层。

title: Interpretable ensemble learning for tensile strength prediction and welding process window optimization of friction stir-welded 7N01 aluminum alloy
authors: Xiaocui Wu, Yingjie Zhao, Huijie Zhang, Qi Cheng, Limao Wei, Yuwang Liu
abstract: This study aims to achieve high-accuracy prediction of the ultimate tensile strength (UTS) of friction stir-welded A7N01P-T4 aluminum alloy joints, elucidate the effects of welding parameters on UTS, and optimize the welding process window. Rotational speed, welding speed, and shoulder plunge depth were used as input variables, with UTS as the output. Machine learning models were developed using 27 experimental samples and evaluated by leave-one-out cross-validation. Comparison of decision tree, K-nearest neighbors, and Gaussian process regression identifies decision tree as the best baseline model, with an R 2 of 0.905. An ensemble learning strategy was subsequently introduced to construct a gradient boosting decision tree, increasing R 2 to 0.966, and grid search optimization of its key hyperparameters further improves R 2 to 0.978. SHapley Additive exPlanations analysis shows that the importance of the welding parameters follows the order of welding speed, rotational speed, and shoulder plunge depth, and the identified parameter effects agree well with the experimental results and observed microstructural evolution. The optimized model predicts fully feasible ranges of all the welding parameters for a joint efficiency of at least 90%, and the shoulder plunge depth acts as a key parameter for further refining the high-strength welding process window. These results demonstrate that the proposed approach not only improves the accuracy of UTS prediction but also reveals welding parameter effects and enables optimization of the welding process window, providing a quantitative basis for selecting FSW parameters.
venue: Journal of Materials Research and Technology

infographic.engineering_relevance: The approach provides a quantitative basis for selecting welding parameters, with shoulder plunge depth helping refine the high-strength process window.

zh-Hans.title: 用于7N01铝合金搅拌摩擦焊接头抗拉强度预测与焊接工艺窗口优化的可解释集成学习
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究旨在高精度预测A7N01P-T4铝合金搅拌摩擦焊接头的极限抗拉强度（UTS），阐明焊接参数对UTS的影响，并优化焊接工艺窗口。以旋转速度、焊接速度和轴肩压入深度为输入变量，以UTS为输出。利用27个实验样本构建机器学习模型，并通过留一交叉验证进行评估。通过比较决策树、K近邻和高斯过程回归，确定决策树为最佳基线模型，其R²为0.905。随后引入集成学习策略，构建梯度提升决策树，将R²提高至0.966，并通过网格搜索优化其关键超参数，将R²进一步提高至0.978。SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）分析表明，焊接参数的重要性依次为焊接速度、旋转速度和轴肩压入深度，且所识别的参数影响与实验结果及观察到的微观组织演变高度一致。优化后的模型预测了接头效率至少达到90%时所有焊接参数的完整可行范围，而轴肩压入深度是进一步细化高强度焊接工艺窗口的关键参数。这些结果表明，所提出的方法不仅提高了UTS预测精度，还揭示了焊接参数的影响，并实现了焊接工艺窗口的优化，为搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）参数选择提供了定量依据。

infographic.key_insight: 优化后的梯度提升决策树以R² = 0.978的精度预测了7N01铝合金搅拌摩擦焊接头的强度，并确定了以接头效率至少达到90%为目标的焊接工艺窗口。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该方法为焊接参数选择提供了定量依据，其中轴肩压入深度有助于细化高强度工艺窗口。

比较基线模型，然后利用网格搜索优化梯度提升模型的超参数。
利用SHAP解释参数影响，并确定预测的高强度工艺窗口。
infographic.evidence_signal: 基于27个实验样本和留一交叉验证，所报告的R²从决策树基线模型的0.905提高至梯度提升模型的0.966，并在调参后达到0.978。

title: Phase Evolution and Structure–Property Relationships of Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1 Coatings with Low GFA Produced by Atmospheric Plasma Spraying
authors: Inez Kredowska, Wirginia Pilarczyk, Aleksandra Małachowska, Paweł Sokołowski, Katarzyna Młynarek-Żak, Paweł M. Nuckowski
abstract: coatings were deposited by APS in order to investigate the influence of spray distance on microstructural development and structure-property relationships. Despite the rapid solidification conditions associated with APS, all coatings exhibited predominantly crystalline multiphase microstructures composed of α-Fe(Si) and Fe-Zr intermetallic phases, with no detectable amorphous fraction in the XRD patterns. The coatings developed a characteristic lamellar morphology with porosity ranging from 2.2 to 4.9%, strongly dependent on spray distance and particle thermal history. Increasing spray distance promoted higher hardness and improved wear resistance but simultaneously deteriorated corrosion resistance due to increased porosity and interlamellar defect population. Among the investigated conditions, the coating deposited at 90 mm exhibited the most favourable balance of hardness, wear resistance, and electrochemical behaviour owing to its relatively dense and cohesive microstructure. The results demonstrate that phase evolution in low-GFA Fe-Zr-Si-Cu alloys processed by APS is governed not only by rapid cooling rates but also by splat-based solidification, repeated thermal cycling, and heterogeneous nucleation during coating build-up.

infographic.key_insight: Atmospheric plasma spraying produced predominantly crystalline Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1 coatings, with spray distance controlling the trade-off between hardness, wear resistance, and corrosion resistance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: A 90 mm spray distance offered the most favorable tested balance of mechanical performance and electrochemical behavior through a relatively dense, cohesive microstructure.
method: Deposit low-glass-forming-ability Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1 coatings by atmospheric plasma spraying at varied spray distances.

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂制备的低玻璃形成能力（GFA）Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1涂层的相演变及结构–性能关系
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）沉积涂层，以研究喷涂距离对微观组织演变及结构–性能关系的影响。尽管APS具有快速凝固条件，所有涂层仍呈现以晶态为主的多相微观组织，由α-Fe(Si)和Fe-Zr金属间化合物相组成，XRD图谱中未检测到非晶相。涂层形成了典型的层片状形貌，孔隙率为2.2%至4.9%，且强烈依赖于喷涂距离和颗粒热历史。增大喷涂距离提高了硬度并改善了耐磨性，但同时因孔隙率和层片间缺陷数量增加而降低了耐腐蚀性。在所研究的条件中，以90 mm喷涂距离沉积的涂层凭借相对致密且结合良好的微观组织，在硬度、耐磨性和电化学行为之间表现出最佳平衡。结果表明，APS加工的低GFA Fe-Zr-Si-Cu合金中的相演变不仅受快速冷却速率控制，还受涂层逐层构建过程中扁平化熔滴的凝固、反复热循环及异质形核的共同影响。

infographic.key_insight: 大气等离子喷涂制备了以晶态为主的Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1涂层，喷涂距离控制着硬度、耐磨性和耐腐蚀性之间的权衡。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 在所测试的条件中，90 mm喷涂距离通过形成相对致密且结合良好的微观组织，实现了力学性能与电化学行为之间的最佳平衡。

infographic.evidence_signal: XRD未检测到非晶相，孔隙率为2.2%–4.9%；增大喷涂距离提高了硬度和耐磨性，但降低了耐腐蚀性。

title: Investigation of the Effect of HVOF Spray Parameters on the Quality Properties of Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr) Coating on Ti6Al4V Substrate
authors: Hariharan Venkataraman, Vishal Uttamrao Bagade, V.M. Biju
abstract: Systematic optimization of high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) spray parameters, such as spray distance, powder feed rate, and fuel gas flow rates, requires numerous experiments to determine the conditions that maximize coating quality. In this study, full factorial design (FFD), a more robust and efficient methodology than the traditional one-factor-at-a-time (OFAT) methodology, was employed to investigate the influence of HVOF spray parameters of Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coating deposited onto a Ti6Al4V substrate. The design of experiments (DOE) approach using an FFD with 24 experimental runs was employed to evaluate all input factors at two levels. The coating response properties were measured for each experimental run. Analysis of variance (ANOVA) was used to quantify the contribution of each spray parameter to the output responses. The effect of the interaction between spray parameters, such as spray distance, powder feed rate, and fuel gas flow rates, on the coating properties for this substrate-coating combination has scarcely been reported. Hence, a Pareto chart was also utilized to analyze the interaction effects of the spray parameters on coating properties. Finally, acceptable quality attributes such as hardness, porosity, and oxides were established with the spraying parameters, namely, standoff distance, powder feed rate, hydrogen flow rate, and oxygen flow rate, respectively, at the values of 150 mm, 25 g/min, 475 NLPM, and 205 NLPM.

infographic.key_insight: A factorial study identified HVOF settings yielding acceptable hardness, porosity, and oxide content for Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coatings on Ti6Al4V.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The reported settings provide a starting point for coating process development: 150 mm standoff, 25 g/min powder feed, 475 NLPM hydrogen, and 205 NLPM oxygen.
method: Two-level full factorial design with 24 experimental runs.
ANOVA quantified spray-parameter contributions to coating responses.
Pareto analysis assessed parameter interaction effects.

zh-Hans.title: HVOF喷涂参数对Ti6Al4V基体上Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr)涂层质量性能影响的研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 对喷涂距离、送粉速率和燃气流量等超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）参数进行系统优化，需要开展大量实验，以确定使涂层质量最优的条件。本研究采用全因子设计（FFD），考察HVOF喷涂参数对沉积在Ti6Al4V基体上的Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr)涂层的影响；与传统的单因素逐次试验（OFAT）方法相比，该方法更稳健且更高效。研究采用包含24次实验的两水平FFD试验设计（DOE）方法，对所有输入因素进行评估。每次实验均测量涂层的响应性能。采用方差分析（ANOVA）量化各喷涂参数对输出响应的贡献。对于这一基体与涂层组合，关于喷涂距离、送粉速率和燃气流量等喷涂参数之间的交互作用对涂层性能影响的报道极少。因此，还使用帕累托图分析喷涂参数对涂层性能的交互作用效应。最终，当喷涂距离、送粉速率、氢气流量和氧气流量分别为150 mm、25 g/min、475 NLPM和205 NLPM时，涂层的硬度、孔隙率和氧化物等质量指标达到可接受水平。

infographic.key_insight: 一项因子试验研究确定了可使Ti6Al4V基体上Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr)涂层的硬度、孔隙率和氧化物含量达到可接受水平的HVOF工艺参数。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 所报告的参数可作为涂层工艺开发的起点：喷涂距离150 mm、送粉速率25 g/min、氢气流量475 NLPM、氧气流量205 NLPM。
method: 采用两水平全因子设计，共进行24次实验。
采用ANOVA量化喷涂参数对涂层响应的贡献。
采用帕累托分析评估参数交互作用效应。
infographic.evidence_signal: 每次实验均测量了涂层性能，但摘要未提供质量指标的数值结果或不确定性估计。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Dense, low-porosity Fe-based amorphous coatings favor long-term corrosion resistance, while higher humidity reduces their friction coefficient and wear rate.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing detonation-spray parameters to limit coating defects may improve protection of Q235 steel, with wear performance also dependent on operating humidity.
method: Detonation-spray Fe-based amorphous coatings onto Q235 carbon steel under varied spraying parameters.
Examine droplet morphology, coating porosity, and lamellar microstructure.
Evaluate long-term corrosion and sliding wear under different humidity conditions using Si3N4 balls.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports poorer long-term corrosion resistance with greater porosity and decreasing friction coefficient and wear rate as humidity increases, but provides no numerical results.
infographic.watch_item: Humidity-dependent wear trends involve Si3N4–water tribochemistry and may not generalize to other counterface materials.
infographic.paper_title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments

zh-Hans.title: 铁基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为及其在不同湿度环境下的磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用不同喷涂参数，通过爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上成功制备了铁基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀行为和摩擦学行为。液滴呈圆盘状形貌，具有最高的圆度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷并形成微观组织致密的细层片结构涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷越多，其长期耐腐蚀性越低。此外，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对不同湿度条件下涂层的磨损行为起着重要作用。随着湿度升高，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率降低。

infographic.key_insight: 致密、低孔隙率的铁基非晶涂层有利于提高长期耐腐蚀性，而较高湿度可降低其摩擦系数和磨损率。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化爆炸喷涂参数以减少涂层缺陷，可能改善对Q235钢的防护效果；磨损性能也取决于工作环境湿度。
method: 采用不同喷涂参数，通过爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上制备铁基非晶涂层。
考察液滴形貌、涂层孔隙率及层片微观结构。
评估长期腐蚀行为，并使用Si3N4球评估不同湿度条件下的滑动磨损行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要指出，孔隙率越高，长期耐腐蚀性越差；随着湿度升高，摩擦系数和磨损率降低，但未提供数值结果。
infographic.watch_item: 磨损随湿度变化的趋势涉及Si3N4与水之间的摩擦化学作用，可能不适用于其他对偶材料。

title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
authors: Vyacheslav Sirota, Sergey Savotchenko, Valeriya Strokova, Daniil Podgornyi, Marina Kovaleva
abstract: The surface properties of metal-ceramic coatings based on titanium dioxide are described in dependence on the detonation spraying conditions. It is found that such properties as surface roughness, surface thickness and its hydrophobicity can be controlled in the production process by selecting certain values of the technological parameters of the spraying process. The optimal values of the technological parameters of detonation spraying, ensuring maximum hydrophobicity of the produced coatings are determined. The roughness of the coating surface and the coating thickness depend on the speed of the nozzle passage in accordance with the inverse power law. The roughness and the contact angle depend on spray distance in accordance with a parabolic law. New equations are obtained that can be useful for predicting the characteristics of the coating surface, as well as for determining the optimal mode of spraying the coating, ensuring its best hydrophobicity.
venue: Iranian Journal of Materials Science and Engineering

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-spraying parameters can tune the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium-dioxide-based metal–ceramic coatings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide nozzle-speed and spray-distance selection to target coating geometry and maximize hydrophobicity.
method: Vary detonation-spraying conditions for titanium-dioxide-based coatings.
Assess surface roughness, coating thickness, and contact angle.
Derive parameter–property equations and identify conditions for maximum hydrophobicity.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships between nozzle travel speed and both roughness and thickness, plus parabolic relationships linking spray distance to roughness and contact angle.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical optimum, tested parameter ranges, or prediction errors, limiting direct transfer to production.
infographic.paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions

zh-Hans.title: 不同工艺条件下爆炸喷涂制备的钛基涂层的表面特性
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文描述了二氧化钛基金属陶瓷涂层的表面性能与爆炸喷涂条件之间的关系。研究发现，通过选择喷涂工艺参数的特定值，可在生产过程中控制表面粗糙度、表层厚度及其疏水性等性能。确定了使所制备涂层具有最大疏水性的爆炸喷涂工艺参数最优值。涂层表面粗糙度和涂层厚度与喷嘴移动速度之间呈反幂律关系。粗糙度和接触角与喷涂距离之间呈抛物线关系。研究得到了新的方程，可用于预测涂层表面特性，以及确定使涂层具有最佳疏水性的最优喷涂工况。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂参数可调控二氧化钛基金属陶瓷涂层的粗糙度、厚度和疏水性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 所报告的关系可指导喷嘴移动速度和喷涂距离的选择，以获得目标涂层几何特征并使疏水性最大化。
method: 改变二氧化钛基涂层的爆炸喷涂条件。
评估表面粗糙度、涂层厚度和接触角。
推导参数与性能之间的关系方程，并确定使疏水性最大化的条件。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了喷嘴移动速度与粗糙度及厚度之间的反幂律关系，以及喷涂距离与粗糙度及接触角之间的抛物线关系。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未提供最优参数的具体数值、所测试的参数范围或预测误差，因此难以直接应用于生产。
